silent-hero.title: View of two U.S. spacecraft on the surface of the moon
silent-hero.caption: Charles Conrad Jr. checks Surveyor 3’s TV camera, with the Apollo 12 lander behind
silent-hero.alt: An astronaut in a white suit beside the spindly Surveyor 3 lander on grey lunar ground, with the Apollo 12 lunar module small on the horizon under a black sky.

passport-l1.title: Soviet Union Lunar Rovers
passport-l1.caption: Luna 17, which carried Lunokhod 1, seen from orbit by LRO
passport-l1.alt: Grey cratered ground on Mare Imbrium seen from orbit, with an arrow pointing at the small bright Luna 17 lander.

passport-l2.title: Luna 21 Lander
passport-l2.caption: Luna 21, which carried Lunokhod 2, and the rover’s tracks, seen by LRO
passport-l2.alt: The bright Luna 21 lander seen from orbit on the floor of Le Monnier crater, with faint rover tracks in the grey soil.

class-moon.title: View of a full Moon photographed from Apollo 11 spacecraft
class-moon.caption: The full Moon from Apollo 11 on the way home
class-moon.alt: The full Moon, grey and white with dark seas, against black space.

class-voyager1.title: Voyager 1 Launch
class-voyager1.caption: Voyager 1 lifts off on a Titan Centaur rocket
class-voyager1.alt: A white Titan Centaur rocket rising from its launch tower above a cloud of orange lit smoke.

nope-dss14.title: Goldstone’s 70-Meter Antenna Under the Stars
nope-dss14.caption: The 70 m dish DSS-14 at Goldstone, California, pointing at the night sky
nope-dss14.alt: A huge white radio dish on a lit steel frame, tipped up toward a dark sky with faint stars.
